style.backgroundSystem: seamless bright white #FFFFFF for packshots and graphic screens, warm sand sweep #E3D6C4 for the hand scene, cool mist panels #E9EEF1 and #DCE5EC for macro and close
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs inside solid rings, single warm accent #E4762B with pale peach disc fill #F7DCC6
style.lightingSystem: bright even soft studio light, front-left key with a large bounce fill, low contrast, soft contact shadows, controlled highlight falloff, no hard speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean high-volume body-care refill visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of bright white background #FFFFFF, muted slate-blue product label #5E80A3, warm sand scene sweep #E3D6C4 and one orange accent #E4762B; neutral bright even soft studio lighting with a front-left key, large bounce fill and soft contact shadows; matte frosted slab surface #EFEAE4; modern geometric sans-serif kept to sparse blank label bars; thin single-weight line icons inside solid rings on pale peach discs #F7DCC6; clean high-end personal-care product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on packshot angle and constant product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented seals or badges.
noDrift: no invented seals, badges or certificate artwork
style.presentationRules: stable straight-on packshot angle and constant jug scale across the set; hands always cropped at the wrist and no face ever enters frame; every label panel stays as a blank field with empty bars
style.surfaceSystem: matte frosted slab #EFEAE4 for packshots and macro, matte neutral board #F3EFE9 for close crops, glossy seamless sweep for the hand scene
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, sparse label lines kept as blank placeholder bars
